note: Original description of a new species, 1965; both the alate and the soldier are described, the measurements in Table 48 (3 alates) and Table 49 (9 soldiers).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is close to P. silvaticus, differing in the pronotum being slightly more than half as long as wide (in P. silvaticus slightly less than half as wide); in P. angustignathus antennal segments 3 and 4 are equal in length and the body colour is darker. The soldier is close to P. silvaticus in size, in the shape of the left mandible and in antennal segment 3 being longer than segment 2, differing in the labrum being distinctly longer than wide, with a straight anterior margin and only shallowly undulate lateral margins (in P. silvaticus the labrum is almost as long as wide, with strongly curved sides and a deeply concave anterior margin), and in the median suture not extending to the fontanelle; the soldier of P. angustignathus has antennal segments 3 and 4 equal in length and is larger; in P. tikadari the hook of the left mandible is smaller and almost a sharp point, the anterior margin of the labrum is more deeply concave, and the postmentum is narrower.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown with a yellow tinge; postclypeus slightly paler than the head; labrum and antennae yellowish brown. Cephalic surface moderately hairy, with short hairs and long setae; labrum sparsely hairy; pronotum as densely hairy as the head. Head wider than long, semicircular below the compound eyes; fontanelle plate distinctly raised, oval; the suture visible only on the posterior half of the head. Compound eyes projecting, nearly circular. Ocelli distinct, elongate-oval, 1.5 times as long as wide, separated from the compound eyes by almost their short diameter. Postclypeus distinctly shorter than half its length. Antennae incomplete; segment 2 1.5 times as long as segment 3, almost equal in length to segment 4; segment 3 the shortest. Pronotum narrower than the head, slightly more than half as long as wide; neither the anterior nor the posterior margin distinctly concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow; labrum milky white; mandibles dark reddish brown; antennae pale yellowish brown; thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Cephalic surface very sparsely hairy; the anterior part of the labrum with a few long setae; apex of the postmentum with 2 short hairs; anterior margin of the pronotum with a few minute hairs, the posterolateral margins with a few long setae, the disc bare. Head oblong, slightly less than twice as long as wide; lateral margins almost parallel; posterior margin convex, slightly concave; the median suture reaching the middle of the head; fontanelle distinct. Labrum 1.5 times as long as wide; anterior margin straight, the anterolateral corners prolonged into short, slender, acute processes. Mandibles asymmetrical; left mandible moderately twisted, its tip produced into a distinct inwardly curved hook; right mandible untwisted, broad, blade-like. Postmentum more than three times as long as its greatest width, constricted in the middle; posterior margin slightly wider than the anterior. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 distinctly longer than segments 2 and 4, slightly shorter than segment 5. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, both anterior and posterior margins slightly concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm, Table 48, 3 alates; Table 49, 9 soldiers; holotype / range / mean given). Alate: head length to the tip of the labrum 1.22/1.19—1.24/1.20; head length to the mandible base 0.70/0.70—0.80/0.76; head width 1.01/1.01—1.10/1.05; diameter of the compound eye 0.26/0.26—0.28/0.27; distance from the lower margin of the compound eye 0.03/0.03—0.07/0.05; ocellus length 0.10/0.10—0.14/0.11; ocellus width 0.06/0.06—0.09/0.07; ocellus to compound eye 0.07/0.07/0.07; postclypeus length 0.15/0.15—0.16/0.15; postclypeus width 0.44/0.41—0.44/0.43; pronotum length 0.46/0.44—0.46/0.45; pronotum width 0.85/0.83—0.85/0.84. Soldier: head length to the mandible base 1.95/1.95—2.23/2.11; head width 1.17/1.17—1.27/1.22; left mandible length 1.84/1.76—1.97/1.85; right mandible length 1.79/1.69—1.87/1.79; postmentum length 0.93/0.91—1.17/1.04; postmentum greatest width 0.28/0.28—0.33/0.30; postmentum narrowest width 0.15/0.15—0.16/0.15; pronotum length 0.26/0.26—0.28/0.27; pronotum width 0.67/0.67—0.75/0.70. Type locality Tung Sa-Lang Luang, Thailand: 3 de-alate adults, soldiers and workers collected under a log on 1962-04-14, soldiers and workers under a log on 1962-04-13.
